title: Pneumatische Vorrichtung zum Ausstrecken von Struempfen und dergleichen Warenstuecken

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
The grip portion is a hollow body
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion

A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate

claims.note: This reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.
This reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor does it mention a sound-damping device.
This reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, not a grip unit with a sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, not a grip unit with a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device arranged in a first housing portion.
This reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, not a grip unit with a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, but does not mention a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion with an air outlet on the second housing portion.
The reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, but does not mention an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion.
The reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, but does not mention bent or curved air baffles downstream of a grip portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.
The reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, but does not mention a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing.
This reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
(non-English passage at claim 4) The reference describes a pneumatic device for handling goods, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not disclose a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to it and extending around it.
The claim refers to 'said grip unit according to claim 1', but claim 1 is not provided in the prompt, making it impossible to assess this limitation.
This reference does not describe a grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device.
This reference does not describe a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum between a suction plate and an object.

overall.why: The reference describes a pneumatic device for stretching stockings, which is a different technical problem and solution than the subject invention's focus on a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit and sound-damping features.
